tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Full-text search across every blog post (title, description, headings, FAQs and body). Returns the best matches with URL, date, description and a snippet around the match.

tools.name: get_post
tools.description: Returns one post in full as Markdown, including its FAQ section. Pass the slug from search_posts / list_posts, or the post's URL.

tools.name: list_posts
tools.description: Lists published posts, newest first, with URL, date and description.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_posts · Public sink: search_posts, get_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_posts, get_post, list_posts · Public sink: search_posts, get_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
